title: Config
description: config.json (data folder root): daemon settings the user writes by hand. Type Config in src/core/types.ts; never written by the daemon or CLI, only read by Store.config in src/core/store.ts, which merges the file's keys over the defaults { port: 7777, prPollMinutes: 5 } (missing or unparseable file: the defaults). So every key is optional in the file. CKANBAN_PORT wins over port, CKANBAN_REMOTE_PORT over remotePort. Unknown fields must be kept.

prPollMinutes.description: Default 5. Kept in the type; no code reads it today.

remotePort.description: Loopback port `tailscale serve` points at for phone access. Missing: port + 1 (remoteListenPort in src/integrations/remote.ts).
